title: Locally finite precise refinements of open covers of closed subsets
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space that is paracompact, meaning that every open cover admits a locally finite open refinement. Let $S\subseteq X$ be closed, with its subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology], let $I$ be a set, and let $(U_a)_{a\in I}$ be open subsets of $X$ with $S\subseteq\bigcup_{a\in I}U_a$. Then there are open subsets $(W_a)_{a\in I}$ of $X$ such that $S\subseteq\bigcup_{a\in I}W_a$, $W_a\subseteq U_a$ for every $a$, and $(W_a)_{a\in I}$ is locally finite in $X$: every point of $X$ has an open neighborhood meeting only finitely many of the $W_a$.
